checks.title: Confirm proposal journey and owners
checks.instructions: Name seller, commercial reviewer, exact first result, excluded actions and whether two Crew identities are required by access or accountability.

checks.title: Bind exact account, opportunity and meeting
checks.instructions: Record tenant, CRM account/opportunity, calendar meeting ID and time zone, offer and current owner. Resolve ambiguous company identities before handoff.

checks.title: Confirm approved product and discovery claims
checks.instructions: Record approved product source, notes approval process, source freshness, privacy rules and which claims need legal or product review.

checks.title: Confirm currency and commercial authority
checks.instructions: Bind current price list version, quantities, tax/discount treatment, approval limits, proposal format and recipient review policy. No unsupported price or deadline.

checks.title: Bind Call Briefing and Proposal Crews
checks.instructions: Inspect existing Crew skills and access. Reuse compatible Sales Call Briefing Assistant and Proposal Drafter, with optional Account Researcher; record exact Crew IDs and pack setup status.

checks.title: Probe one real CRM, meeting and price source
checks.instructions: Read authorized invite/CRM data, approved product material and pricing. Record IDs, revisions, observed times and gaps. A named connector is not proof.

checks.title: Validate brief, approved notes and proposal
checks.instructions: Run the packaged validator on sales-call-brief/v1 and sales-proposal-draft/v1. Stop for wrong account/meeting, missing approved post-call note, unsupported scope, price mismatch or false sent state.

checks.title: Review concrete Automation proposal
checks.instructions: Show Crew IDs, source and artifact paths, blocking validator steps, privacy and cost, human note approval, commercial review, action ledger and separate send route.

checks.title: Run one real case manually
checks.instructions: Use a real authorized meeting and reviewed post-call note. Save both Crew results, owner corrections and validator output; if notes are absent, stop truthfully after the brief. Fictional fixtures do not complete setup.

checks.title: Choose manual or reviewed repeat route
checks.instructions: Manual-only is valid. Any calendar or CRM event trigger must authenticate source, bind IDs, deduplicate, set retry/cost policy and keep proposal delivery separately approved.
